title: A fixed K1788 score gives a cancellation-aware variational lower bound for full Fisher information

certificate.cauchy_cross_multiplication: J*B >= A^2; B>0; A^2-T*B>0 implies J>T

method: Fix h to the exact K1788 boundary-KKT score. For every varying parameter theta, Cauchy in L2(p_theta) gives J(theta) B(theta) >= A(theta)^2. Expanding p_theta s_theta cancels the varying mixture denominator from A; B contains that denominator only linearly.
scope_guard: This is a rigorous lower-bound mechanism. Equality holds at the anchor score and is not asserted elsewhere. Numerical or interval work must still prove A^2-threshold*B positive on the claimed parameter domain.
